_about: Fixture trees for misc/tests/test_sync_classes.py. Each case starts from a base tree (a classes/ folder and member skills, built in a temp dir), applies `files` (null deletes a path), runs a write when `presync` is set, applies `mutate`, then runs misc/sync-classes.py in each mode of `run` and checks `expect`. `unchanged` means no file in the tree changed during the runs. Case ids follow the P-310 sketch's fixture table (F0 to F17).
